latest_release.body:
- **[Feature]**: metro-cache: `HttpStore` accepts `maxSockets`, to change its connection limit, and `getParams`, to add query parameters (such as a short-lived credential) to every request (https://github.com/react/metro/pull/2246 by @GijsWeterings)
 - **[Feature]**: `Transforming file` end log entries report the worker's CPU time for the transform as `cpu_time_us` (https://github.com/react/metro/pull/2282 by @vzaidman)
 - **[Fix]**: Keep function bindings that are reassigned when folding constants in production builds (https://github.com/react/metro/pull/2197 by @Mwrnk)
 - **[Fix]**: Keep side effects such as `i++` in the leading operands of a sequence when folding constants in production builds (https://github.com/react/metro/pull/2278 by @burrows99)
 - **[Fix]**: Keep a `var` declared in a branch that's removed when folding constants in production builds, if code outside the branch uses it, instead of throwing a `ReferenceError` (https://github.com/react/metro/pull/2279 by @burrows99)
 - **[Fix]**: Don't replace `void 0` with `undefined` when folding constants in production builds, where `undefined` is shadowed (https://github.com/react/metro/pull/2215 by @ZainnQureshii)
 - **[Fix]**: Memoized inline requires: A module first referenced in a skipped optional chain, logical assignment or default value is no longer `undefined` at later references (https://github.com/react/metro/pull/2280 by @burrows99)
 - **[Fix]**: `experimentalImportSupport`: `export * from` a module with an enumerable `__esModule` no longer throws in strict mode (https://github.com/react/metro/pull/2281 by @burrows99)
 - **[Fix]**: Define a `__proto__` key in JSON modules as an own property, matching `JSON.parse` (https://github.com/react/metro/pull/2199 by @Mwrnk)
 - **[Fix]**: `FileStore` writes cache entries atomically, so concurrent reads no longer miss valid entries or see partial writes (https://github.com/react/metro/pull/2040 by @frankleng)
 - **[Fix]**: Respect `excludeSource` in inline source maps, and pass it to `serializer.customSerializer` (https://github.com/react/metro/pull/2256 by @robhogan)
 - **[Fix]**: Stop leaking a graph's `DeltaCalculator` and file change listener when its first build fails (https://github.com/react/metro/pull/2283 by @sensei-woo)
 - **[Fix]**: Resolve a package subpath ending in `/.`, such as `pkg/.`, instead of throwing `Unexpectedly escaped traversal` (https://github.com/react/metro/pull/2213 by @kwy404)
 - **[Fix]**: Fix `resolver.blockList: []` hiding every file (https://github.com/react/metro/commit/8f49d3681cfd)
 - **[Fix]**: Fix an out-of-memory crash on a symlink into itself (https://github.com/react/metro/pull/2204 by @robhogan)
 - **[Fix]**: Fix the path of a file added through a symlink to the project root (https://github.com/react/metro/pull/2212 by @robhogan)
 - **[Fix]**: Fix `Failed to collapse` on a path through a symlink out of the project root, into a directory whose name ends in `.` (https://github.com/react/metro/pull/2237 by @robhogan)
 - **[Fix]**: `require.context` on a directory above the project root follows symlinks inside the project root, and lists each level correctly from two or more levels up (https://github.com/react/metro/pull/2229 by @robhogan)
 - **[Fix]**: Use a separate file map cache under Bun, which can't read Node's cache (https://github.com/react/metro/pull/2209 by @robhogan)
 - **[Fix]**: Include dependencies required by Metro's published TypeScript declarations (https://github.com/react/metro/pull/2149 by @sorinc03)
 - **[Performance]**: Dev server memory is ~95% lower per lazy-loaded route (`import()` or async routes), and lazy bundle requests are ~2x faster (https://github.com/react/metro/pull/2239 by @robhogan)
 - **[Performance]**: Without Watchman, the dev server is ready to bundle ~2.5-3x faster on Linux and Windows, and ~15% faster on macOS (https://github.com/react/metro/pull/2104, https://github.com/react/metro/pull/2105, https://github.com/reac

detail.readme:
# Metro

[![MIT licensed](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](https://github.com/react/metro/blob/HEAD/LICENSE)
[![npm package version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/metro?color=brightgreen)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/metro)
[![react/metro/nightly-tests](https://github.com/react/metro/actions/workflows/nightly-tests.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/react/metro/actions/workflows/nightly-tests.yml)
[![Code coverage](https://codecov.io/gh/react/metro/branch/main/graph/badge.svg?token=oMHdoKhFZB)](https://codecov.io/gh/react/metro)
[![Follow @MetroBundler on Twitter](https://img.shields.io/twitter/follow/MetroBundler?style=social)](https://twitter.com/intent/follow?screen_name=MetroBundler)

🚇 The JavaScript bundler for React Native.

- **🚅 Fast**: We aim for sub-second reload cycles, fast startup and quick bundling speeds.
- **⚖️ Scalable**: Works with thousands of modules in a single application.
- **⚛️ Integrated**: Supports every React Native project out of the box.

## Installation

Metro is included with React Native — see the [React Native docs](https://reactnative.dev/docs/getting-started) to quickly get started ⏱️.

To add Metro to an existing project, see our [Getting Started guide](https://metrobundler.dev/docs/getting-started).

## Documentation

All available documentation, including on [configuring Metro](https://metrobundler.dev/docs/configuration), can be found on the [Metro website](https://metrobundler.dev/docs/getting-started).

Source code for documentation is located in this repository under `docs/`.

## Contributing

Metro was previously part of the [react-native](https://github.com/facebook/react-native) repository. In this standalone repository it is easier for the team working on Metro to respond to issues and pull requests. See [react-native#13976](https://github.com/facebook/react-native/issues/13976) for the initial announcement.

### [Code of Conduct](https://code.fb.com/codeofconduct)

Meta has adopted a Code of Conduct that we expect project participants to adhere to. Please read [the full text](https://code.fb.com/codeofconduct) so that you can understand what actions will and will not be tolerated.

### [Contributing guide](https://github.com/react/metro/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)

Read our [contributing guide](https://github.com/react/metro/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) to learn about our development process, how to propose bug fixes and improvements, and how to build and test your changes to Metro.

### Package managers

Metro is developed with Yarn (v1), and `yarn.lock` is the source of truth for dependency versions - commit changes to `yarn.lock`, not `pnpm-lock.yaml`.

pnpm is also supported, by generating a (git-ignored) `pnpm-lock.yaml` from `yarn.lock`:

```sh
pnpm import
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
```

### Discussions

Larger discussions and proposals concerning React Native and Metro are discussed in [**@react-native-community/discussions-and-proposals**](https://github.com/react-native-community/discussions-and-proposals).

## License

Metro is MIT licensed, as found in the LICENSE file.
